A0254.title: High-Frequency Cancellation and Quote Stuffing Detection
A0254.definition: Monitor dense order submissions, cancellations, quote updates, and channel usage to detect quote stuffing, flickering orders, and cancellation disruption.
A0254.description:
High-frequency cancellation and quote stuffing detection collects order rate, cancellation rate, quote-update interval, order lifetime, channel usage, matching latency, and synchronized behavior across account/device clusters. Rate thresholds, anomaly baselines, burst-window detection, and common-control clustering identify quote stuffing, flickering orders, and noise generation through matching latency.

This control applies to market microstructure manipulation and order-book spoofing. It focuses on behavior that consumes market-data, matching, or risk-control resources without genuine execution intent. Deployment should distinguish legitimate high-frequency market making from disruptive trading by combining execution contribution, order lifecycle, and venue rules.
A0254.limitation: Legitimate high-frequency market making can also have high cancellation rates, so simple thresholds may harm liquidity providers. Attackers can split activity across accounts, memberships, venues, or lower bursts, requiring cross-account clustering and venue-rule interpretation.

references.title: CFTC Interpretive Guidance and Policy Statement on Disruptive Trading Practices

keywords: High-Frequency Cancellation and Quote Stuffing Detection
